$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007, FLR-ADR-065): FS_energy 0.1.0, registry/FS_energy/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_energy, by a validator that implements FS_energy and knows it (spec.md 1.2). The core members of an element (fallback, host, clearances, option, name, extras) are checked by Floorspec Core, so this schema only names them. An array's roof and face, its free host on the roof's level and its rotation, and the arrays an inverter or a shutdown initiator lists are checked by the invariants (spec.md 2.2, 2.3, 3.1 and 3.2).
